key_insight: This paper introduces L3Cube-MahaPOS, a new Marathi part-of-speech tagging dataset and baseline BERT models to improve NLP support for a highly under-resourced language. It helps close the gap between Marathi and better-resourced languages by providing standard data and evaluation tools.
problem_solved: Marathi NLP lacks large annotated corpora and consistent benchmarks for POS tagging, making it difficult to build and compare effective models. The paper addresses the challenges of Marathi’s rich morphology, free word order, and limited standardized resources.
method: Created L3Cube-MahaPOS, a Marathi POS tagging dataset for supervised evaluation.
Trained and evaluated BERT-based models as strong neural baselines for Marathi POS tagging.
Established a standardized benchmark to support future Marathi NLP research and model comparison.
impact: For AI/ML practitioners, this work provides the missing infrastructure needed to develop and benchmark Marathi language models more reliably. It can accelerate downstream applications like machine translation, parsing, and information extraction for Marathi text.
